description.subtitle: Brazil 2026 Nike Pre-Match Warm-Up Shirt - Light Green, Turquoise
description.intro: The Nike Brazil 2026 Pre-Match Academy Pro Jersey is designed for the pre-match moments, offering the same style that players wear during warm-ups. Its graphic design reflects the creativity and rhythm of Brazilian football.
key_benefits: Dri-FIT Technology: Evacuates sweat to keep skin dry and comfortable.
Pre-match design: Used by players during warm-up.
Lightweight fabric: Offers comfort and freedom of movement.
Comfortable fit: Ideal for workouts and everyday use.
Official design: With Brazil shield for an authentic look.

key_benefits: Tecnología Dri-FIT: Evacúa el sudor para mantener la piel seca y cómoda.
